title: Application ServiceDiscovery Consul Entity
description: Consul-specific configuration. Extends Application/ServiceDiscovery with Consul-specific settings.

server.description: Whether this agent runs in server mode (true) or client mode (false).

bootstrap_expect.description: Number of server agents expected for quorum bootstrap.

retry_join.description: Addresses of other agents to join on startup.

ui_enabled.description: Whether the Consul web UI is enabled.

encrypt_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for the gossip encryption key.

dns_config.description: DNS configuration for Consul's built-in DNS server.

allow_stale.description: Whether stale reads are allowed for DNS queries.

max_stale.description: Maximum staleness allowed for DNS responses (e.g., 5s).
